task: Verify source-free multi-statement generic and nested private helper closure across independent consumer types
observation: The existing staged ABI-v10 harness ran a removed-source generic provider, and a reduced probe used one .mossi/.rlib to run independently compiled Int and String consumers (99 and hello). The apparent success came from generic_stmt fallback: inspect reported missing_typed_facts for fresh and both private helpers, while the interface had no private_semantic_dependencies or provenance records and only a hashless private helper name.
impact: Native output alone could falsely certify H3 even though checked open summaries, versioned body IR, and exact dependency/provenance hashes were absent from the source-free contract.

resolution.summary: A staged-only pre-link SOURCE_FREE_CHECKED_BODY_UNAVAILABLE guard now rejects the unsupported exported private multi-statement chain; typed summary closure and canonical checked body/dependency/provenance records remain required for H3.
